# The current care card is half a page

The card names current contacts, choices Mum made and the next review date. Old drafts live in the folder rather than on the fridge. [[Care arrangements]] now supports decisions without narrating every aspect of her life. The choir concert was good; I want to remember that as well as the arrangements that got us there.
